name: @sulo/extension
description: Pendamping akademik untuk mahasiswa Unhas. Tidak resmi.
author: Ikrar Gempur Tirani

scripts.build: node scripts/check-leaks.mjs && wxt build && node scripts/check-no-dev-code.mjs ../../.output/chrome-mv3 --production && node scripts/check-leaks.mjs ../../.output/chrome-mv3 && node scripts/check-neosia-main.mjs ../../.output/chrome-mv3
scripts.zip:store: node scripts/check-leaks.mjs && wxt zip && node scripts/check-no-dev-code.mjs ../../.output/chrome-mv3 --production && wxt zip -b edge && node scripts/check-no-dev-code.mjs ../../.output/edge-mv3 --production && node scripts/check-release.mjs ../../.output/chrome-mv3 ../../.output/edge-mv3 && node scripts/check-leaks.mjs ../../.output/chrome-mv3 ../../.output/edge-mv3 && node scripts/check-neosia-main.mjs ../../.output/chrome-mv3 && node scripts/check-neosia-main.mjs ../../.output/edge-mv3 && node scripts/check-leaks.mjs --zip ../../.output/sulo-{version}-chrome.zip --zip ../../.output/sulo-{version}-edge.zip
scripts.zip:tester: wxt zip --mode tester && node scripts/check-no-dev-code.mjs ../../.output/chrome-mv3-tester && node scripts/check-leaks.mjs ../../.output/chrome-mv3-tester && node scripts/check-neosia-main.mjs ../../.output/chrome-mv3-tester && node scripts/check-leaks.mjs --zip ../../.output/sulo-{version}-chrome-tester.zip
